intro_zh: 南昌是江西省省会，赣江穿城，是「英雄城」（八一南昌起义所在地），也是滕王阁所在的历史文化名城。
intro_en: Nanchang, capital of Jiangxi, is split by the Gan River. The 'Heroic City' where the August 1st Uprising began, it is also the historic home of the Tengwang Pavilion.
culture_zh: 红色文化与赣鄱文化在此交汇，王勃一篇《滕王阁序》让南昌名传千古，瓦罐汤是市井的暖意。
culture_en: Revolutionary heritage meets Gan-Poyang culture here; Wang Bo's preface to the Tengwang Pavilion made Nanchang immortal, and clay-pot soup is the warmth of its streets.

attractions.desc_zh: 江南三大名楼之一，凭栏赣江。
attractions.desc_en: One of the three great towers south of the Yangtze, overlooking the Gan River.

attractions.desc_zh: 城市中心广场，纪念南昌起义。
attractions.desc_en: The central city square commemorating the Nanchang Uprising.

attractions.desc_zh: 赣江畔的音乐喷泉，夜景璀璨。
attractions.desc_en: Musical fountains on the bank of the Gan River, dazzling at night.
attractions.img: 南昌 秋水广场 喷泉

foods.desc_zh: 瓦罐久煨的汤品，配拌粉是经典早餐。
foods.desc_en: Soup slow-simmered in clay pots, classic with mixed rice noodles for breakfast.

foods.desc_zh: 爽滑米粉拌上酱料，酸辣开胃。
foods.desc_en: Smooth rice noodles tossed in sauce—sour, spicy and appetizing.

foods.desc_zh: 鄱阳湖藜蒿配腊肉，鲜香爽脆。
foods.desc_en: Poyang Lake artemisia stir-fried with cured pork—fresh and crisp.
